notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least three reprieve counters.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pollenbright Druid, adding one mana of any color.
Pollenbright Druid dies, triggering Magnanimous Magistrate, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Pollenbright Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Pollenbright Druid enters the battlefield, causing you to proliferate, putting two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Repeat.
